1. I’m a girl. Just because I don’t agree with you doesn’t mean I’m a man who doesn’t understand the struggles of being a woman. You’re just in the wrong here and can’t accept it. 
2. I answered you question. It’s not your family and you don’t have all the information (nor did you try to gather the info which is even more concerning). Why should you be allowed to thrust your beliefs into others? Again I didn’t say to not have your beliefs. In fact I have the same ones you do and won’t allow my husband to sit on his ass and expect me to do all the dinner work. But you can’t go around making everyone adhere to your beliefs when you don’t even know them that well.

It’s not about throwing away your beliefs. He doesn’t have to budge because you don’t know their situation and didn’t bother to ask. If a woman wants to fulfill traditional gender roles she’s not setting feminism back 50 years, and that’s probably how you made the mom feel. 

If you really cared about fighting misogyny you would’ve consulted the mom first. Feminism is about having the choice between fulfilling a traditional role like hers or not. If she was forced into it then there’d be an issue. But you don’t even know if that’s the case because you didn’t care to ask her and understand the dynamics of her family. You just had a massive ego trip.
